title: A Tile Inside a Tile
hints: F1 can call F1. Put F1 inside F1, after forward.
In main, call F1 and set its n to 4: it steps forward once for every level.

story.intro: PATCH: "Fractal, a tower made of smaller towers. Here a function can call itself. Each call goes one level deeper, and n says how deep."
story.outro: PATCH: "F1(4) ran forward, then F1(3), then F1(2), then F1(1). At zero it stopped. That stop is the base case."
